name: onejudge-python-sdk
//: The typed async Python SDK, published to PyPI as `onejudge`. Its declarations are generated from the library's Rust wire types (`generate-check`), and its tests drive the real `onejudge` binary and the doubles, so it depends on both. llmlint: ignore-file[projects_stay_in_one_uv_workspace] JSON has no comment to scope this to a line. The SDK runs in its pinned requirements-dev.txt environment through `uv run --no-project`, mirroring oneharness's SDK (the departure AGENTS.md "Stack and composition" records); a uv workspace would have to take in the root maturin pyproject.toml that the unchanged release-pypi.yml builds, which is a change to the release path this project definition does not make.
